name: Motives
overview: Scripture reveals that true motives are known and weighed by the Lord, even when man considers his own ways pure or right (Proverbs 16:2; 21:2). God calls believers to act not for human approval but to please Him alone, warning against performing righteous acts for outward praise (Matthew 6:1; Galatians 1:10). Ultimately, fearing God and obeying His commandments is the foundational duty of man, shaping the heart's intentions beyond mere external actions (Ecclesiastes 12:13; Genesis 4:7).
